name: DDoS / Denial of Service Response Playbook
description: Traffic mitigation and service restoration procedure for DDoS attack on grid network

actions.description: Apply rate limiting to all external traffic ingress — cap to 10% of normal capacity
Blackhole route all identified flood source IPs via BGP null routing
Temporarily isolate overloaded HMI interface to prevent buffer overflow exploitation
Immediately alert network operations team to activate DDoS mitigation procedures
Contact upstream ISP to activate scrubbing center and upstream traffic filtering

recovery_steps: Gradually restore external traffic once attack subsides (monitor for 30min)
Analyze traffic patterns to identify attack vectors for permanent mitigation
Review and update BGP filtering rules
Consider dedicated DDoS protection service if attacks recur
Test SCADA system integrity after restoration
